# 悟真篇闡幽

- DZJY  悟真篇闡幽

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Bringing Out the Hidden Meaning of the Wùzhēnpiān*

base text: [張伯端](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BC%B5%E4%BC%AF%E7%AB%AF) (Zhāng Bóduān, c. 984–1082) — the *Wù zhēn piān* (DZ 263 etc., = [KR5c0167](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0167)); commentary: [朱元育](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%B1%E5%85%83%E8%82%B2) (Zhū Yuányù, *hào* 雲陽道人 Yúnyáng dàorén; fl. mid-late 17th c.)

A three-juàn early-Qīng commentary on Zhāng Bóduān's **Wù zhēn piān** 悟真篇 — the foundational scripture of the Sòng-Yuán *Nán zōng* (Southern Lineage) of Daoist inner-alchemy — by **Zhū Yuányù** (cf. [朱元育](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9C%B1%E5%85%83%E8%82%B2)), the same exegete responsible for [KR5i0037](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0037) *Cān tóng qì chǎn yōu*. The work completes Zhū's *Cāntóng / Wùzhēn* commentary dyad, both grounded in the lineage Zhāng Bìxū → *Língbǎo lǎorén* that Zhū had received in the Zhōngnán mountains.

**Abstract**

The most influential early-Qīng *Wù zhēn piān* commentary, by Zhū Yuányù — completing his *Cāntóng / Wùzhēn* dyad from the Lóngmén southern-school *xìngmìng* synthesis. The work's distinctive feature is its programmatic re-collation of the *Wù zhēn piān*'s order of poems: "this book originally had a sequence; many later hands disordered it, so that it became chaotic and lost its original face. I have respectfully consulted the *zàng* recension, all in accordance with the *jīnyè huándān* operational sequence, and so corrected it." The reordering is significant for the textual history of the *Wù zhēn piān*. Composition c. 1660–1670 (Zhū's *Cān tóng qì chǎn yōu* was 1657; *Wù zhēn piān chǎn yōu* is presumably the immediately following work).
